thread:
ryan: quick report from a new user: generator sample app hangs on auth refresh and ctx cancel. minimal snippet below — user expected ctx cancel to stop everything but range on Chunks() never ends.

ryan: snippet: ```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 15*time.Second)
stream, _ := client.GeneratorStream(ctx, req)
for c := range stream.Chunks() { fmt.Print(c.Text) }
// never reaches final error when auth refresh triggers
```

ryan: observed on sdk v0.8.2.

tian: thanks, this is an API ergonomics issue we've seen. two fixes: (1) make ctx cancellation always close the Chunks() channel and surface Err() == context.Canceled, (2) emit a debug log event when internal auth refresh happens so it isn't invisible.

alla: agreed. sample apps should show `defer stream.Close()` + `if err := stream.Wait(); err != nil { ... }`. we'll add a tiny example and update quickstart text.

kevin: implementation note: add a monitor goroutine that listens on ctx.Done() and calls internalClose(ctx.Err()) to unblock consumers. add tests for mid-stream token refresh + cancel race.

docs-bot: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-go/issues/451 (generator: close on ctx cancel; add Wait/Err and auth-refresh logs).

ryan: awesome, thanks — that should make the sample app less surprising for newcomers. :thumbsup:
